de: Das Modell kann bei der Zuordnung echte Journaldaten lesen

Das Modell erhält die Anweisungen und kann denselben Studio-Archive-Kontext für Mandant, Auftrag und Lauf sowie Beleg und Pfad der ausgewählten Datei sehen. Überschriften, bereitgestellte Inhalte oder normalisierte Zeilen können geöffnet werden, um eine konkrete Zuordnungsunklarheit zu lösen.
Die Prüfung zeigt einen genau begrenzten Auszug

Für jede Datei bereitet die Prüfung höchstens die ersten 20 kanonischen Zeilen auf: Datum, Bewegungs- und Zeilennummern, Konto und Beschreibungen, Soll, Haben, Beträge, Währung, Einheit und Quellposition. Für die Prüfung des PDF-Layouts kann das Modell bis zu 300 Wörter aus jeder der ersten beiden Seiten und der letzten Seite erhalten, mit Koordinaten, Seitengrößen und Dateiprüfsumme; jedes Wort ist auf 100 Zeichen begrenzt. Diese Wörter können echte Falldaten enthalten. Die vollständige Rekonstruktion und die Kontrolle der Buchungssummen erfolgen lokal. Zur Layout-Wiederherstellung kann jede vom Modell angeforderte Prüfung bis zu drei Seiten oder Bereiche mit höchstens 300 Wörtern und 1.200 Zeichen samt Koordinaten pro Seite sowie angeforderte Bilder zeigen. Das Modell liest auch vorgeschlagene Rezepte und Versuchsdiagnosen. Das Verfahren bewahrt den Verlauf in der Fallablage auf, erlaubt vier Versuche und zwölf Prüfungen und sendet diese Daten nicht an Entwickler.
Der Code prüft das gesamte Journal; das Modell erhält die Stichprobe und eine Zusammenfassung

Nach Bestätigung der Spaltenzuordnung prüft und beprobt der Code das gesamte Journal. Das Modell erhält Angaben dazu, wie die Stichprobe ausgewählt wurde, die wichtigsten Zählwerte, den Stand der Kontrollen und Prüfung sowie bis zu 750 ausgewählte Zeilen mit allen 17 Buchungs- und Herkunftsfeldern. Es erhält weder den Mandanten- und Auftragsdatensatz noch interne Dateien zur Steuerung der Prüfung, Computerpfade oder Verarbeitungszeiten. Dateiverweise werden durch neutrale Codes ersetzt.
Dieselbe reduzierte Stichprobe in jeder Variante

Das Modell verwendet immer dieselbe reduzierte Stichprobe. Wenn integrierte Werkzeuge verfügbar sind, prüft der Server die vollständigen Daten lokal, gibt nur die vorgesehenen reduzierten Informationen zurück und kann die Prüfung speichern und anwenden; andernfalls behalten die bereitgestellten Dateien und das lokale Studio-Archive-Verfahren dieselben Grenzen und dieselbe Nachvollziehbarkeit. Technische Verweise werden durch neutrale Codes ersetzt, doch dadurch werden die Fachdaten nicht pseudonymisiert: Namen, Konten, Beschreibungen, Kennungen, Daten und Beträge bleiben bei Bedarf erhalten. Es gibt keine automatische Anonymisierung oder Nur-lokal-Garantie.

Bei der PDF-Wiederherstellung speichert die lokale Prüfung der Schreibweise negativer Beträge alle Auffälligkeiten und zeigt dem Modell höchstens 50 Meldungen pro Antwort mit Seite, Zeile, Spalte und gedrucktem Betrag. Das Modell sieht auch die vorgeschlagene Schreibweise und Behandlung des Vorzeichens; diese erfordern eine fachliche Prüfung. Bei unbekannten PDF-Strukturen kann der Agent Originalwörter mit Seitenverweisen, lokalen Adaptercode und die für die Diagnose benötigten teilweise gelesenen Buchungen lesen. Der Code läuft lokal; unabhängige Prüfungen bleiben verpflichtend. Der Störungsdienst erhält feste technische Kategorien, Prüfergebnisse und Anzahlen, jedoch keine Dokumente, Beträge, Pfade, Adaptercodes oder frei formulierten Begründungen. Erfolgreiches erneutes Einlesen schließt den ursprünglichen Auftrag nicht automatisch ab.

Studio Archive grenzt jede Ausführung dieses Prozesses ab und erstellt automatisch einen Bericht über die von Vera gesendeten Daten. Vera erfasst die eigenen Sendungen; der Bericht untersucht weder den Chat noch andere Werkzeuge. Der Bericht bleibt auf dem Rechner, auch wenn alle Daten gesendet wurden. Fehlende Mengenangaben werden ausdrücklich als unbekannt ausgewiesen. Der Server erhält nur den Berichtshash und die Prüfverweise, gebunden an die Vera userID des Rechners, dieselbe Ausführung und Revision. Berichtsinhalte und Nachweise bleiben lokal.
en: The model can read real journal data during mapping

The model receives the instructions and may see the same Studio Archive client, engagement, and run context plus the selected file receipt and path. Headers, supplied content, or normalized rows may be opened when needed to resolve a specific mapping ambiguity.

For each file, inspection prepares at most the first 20 canonical rows: date, movement and line numbers, account and descriptions, debit, credit, amounts, currency, unit, and source location. For PDF layout review, the model may receive up to 300 words from each of the first two and final pages, with coordinates, page dimensions and the file fingerprint; each word is limited to 100 characters. Those words can contain real case data. Complete reconstruction and registration-total checks run locally. For layout recovery, each model-requested inspection can show up to three pages or regions, with at most 300 words and 1,200 characters with coordinates per page, plus requested images. The model also reads proposed recipes and trial diagnostics. The procedure retains history in the case workspace, allows four trials and twelve inspections, and does not send this data to developers.
Code checks the entire journal; the model receives the sample and a summary

Once the column mapping is confirmed, code checks and samples the entire journal. The model receives how the sample was chosen, the main counts, the status of the checks and review, and up to 750 selected rows with all 17 accounting and source fields. It does not receive the client and engagement record, internal files used to manage the review, computer file paths, or processing times. File references are replaced with neutral codes.
The same reduced sample in every mode

The model always uses the same reduced sample. When integrated tools are available, the server checks the complete data locally, returns only the intended reduced information, and can save and apply the review; otherwise the delivered files and the local Studio Archive procedure preserve the same limits and audit trail. Technical references are replaced with neutral codes, but this does not pseudonymize professional data: names, accounts, descriptions, identifiers, dates, and amounts remain when needed. There is no automatic anonymization or local-only guarantee.

During PDF recovery, the local negative-amount notation check retains every issue and shows the model at most 50 issues per response, with page, row, column and printed amount. The model also sees the proposed notation and sign-treatment choices; these require professional review. For unfamiliar PDF structures, the agent may read original words with page references, run-local adapter code and partial entries needed for diagnosis. Code executes locally and independent checks remain mandatory. The incident service receives fixed technical categories, check results and counts, excluding documents, amounts, paths, adapter code and free-text rationales. A successful reread does not automatically close the original task.

Studio Archive delimits each run of this process and automatically creates a report of the data Vera sent. Vera records its own sends; the report does not inspect the chat or other tools. The report stays on the machine even when all data was sent. Missing counts are explicitly unknown. The server receives only the report hash and verification references, bound to the machine’s Vera userID, the same run and revision. Report contents and evidence remain local.
es: El modelo puede leer datos reales del diario durante la asignación

El modelo recibe las instrucciones y puede ver el mismo contexto Studio Archive del cliente, del encargo y de la ejecución, además del recibo y la ruta del archivo seleccionado. Los encabezados, el contenido aportado o las filas normalizadas pueden abrirse para resolver una ambigüedad concreta de asignación.
La inspección muestra un extracto preciso

Para cada archivo, la inspección prepara como máximo las primeras 20 filas canónicas: fecha, números de movimiento y línea, cuenta y descripciones, debe, haber, importes, moneda, unidad y ubicación en la fuente. Para revisar el diseño del PDF, el modelo puede recibir hasta 300 palabras de cada una de las dos primeras páginas y de la última, con coordenadas, dimensiones de página y huella del archivo; cada palabra se limita a 100 caracteres. Pueden contener datos reales del expediente. La reconstrucción completa y la comprobación de los totales de los asientos se ejecutan localmente. Para recuperar el diseño, cada inspección solicitada por el modelo puede mostrar hasta tres páginas o regiones, con un máximo de 300 palabras y 1.200 caracteres con coordenadas por página, además de las imágenes solicitadas. El modelo también lee las recetas propuestas y los diagnósticos. El procedimiento conserva el historial en el expediente, permite cuatro intentos y doce inspecciones y no envía estos datos a los desarrolladores.
El código revisa todo el diario; el modelo recibe la muestra y un resumen

Una vez confirmada la correspondencia de las columnas, el código revisa y muestrea todo el diario. El modelo recibe cómo se eligió la muestra, los recuentos principales, el estado de los controles y de la revisión, y hasta 750 filas seleccionadas con los 17 campos contables y de origen. No recibe el registro del cliente y del encargo, los archivos internos usados para gestionar la revisión, las rutas del ordenador ni los horarios de procesamiento. Las referencias a archivos se sustituyen por códigos neutros.
La misma muestra reducida en cada modalidad

El modelo utiliza siempre la misma muestra reducida. Cuando están disponibles las herramientas integradas, el servidor comprueba localmente los datos completos, devuelve solo la información reducida prevista y puede guardar y aplicar la revisión; de lo contrario, los archivos entregados y el procedimiento local de Studio Archive mantienen los mismos límites y la misma trazabilidad. Las referencias técnicas se sustituyen por códigos neutros, pero esto no seudonimiza los datos profesionales: nombres, cuentas, descripciones, identificadores, fechas e importes permanecen cuando son necesarios. No hay anonimización automática ni garantía de procesamiento solo local.

Durante la recuperación del PDF, la comprobación local de la notación de importes negativos conserva todas las anomalías y muestra al modelo como máximo 50 incidencias por respuesta, con página, fila, columna e importe impreso. El modelo también ve las opciones propuestas de notación y tratamiento del signo, que requieren revisión profesional. Ante estructuras PDF desconocidas, el agente puede leer palabras originales con referencias de página, código de un adaptador local y asientos parciales necesarios para el diagnóstico. El código se ejecuta localmente y los controles independientes siguen siendo obligatorios. El servicio de incidencias recibe categorías técnicas fijas, resultados de controles y recuentos, sin documentos, importes, rutas, código del adaptador ni explicaciones libres. Una nueva lectura correcta no cierra automáticamente el trabajo original.

Studio Archive delimita cada ejecución de este proceso y crea automáticamente un informe de los datos enviados por Vera. Vera registra sus propios envíos; el informe no inspecciona el chat ni otras herramientas. El informe permanece en el equipo incluso cuando se han enviado todos los datos. Los recuentos que faltan se indican como indeterminados. El servidor recibe únicamente la huella del informe y las referencias de verificación, vinculadas al Vera userID del equipo, a la misma ejecución y revisión. El contenido del informe y las evidencias permanecen locales.
fr: Le modèle peut lire des données réelles du journal pendant le mapping

Le modèle reçoit les instructions et peut voir le même contexte Studio Archive du client, de la mission et de l’exécution ainsi que le reçu et le chemin du fichier sélectionné. Les en-têtes, le contenu fourni ou des lignes normalisées peuvent être ouverts pour résoudre une ambiguïté précise de mapping.

Pour chaque fichier, l'inspection prépare au maximum les 20 premières lignes canoniques : date, numéros de mouvement et de ligne, compte et libellés, débit, crédit, montants, devise, unité et emplacement dans la source. Pour examiner la mise en page PDF, le modèle peut recevoir jusqu’à 300 mots de chacune des deux premières pages et de la dernière, avec leurs coordonnées, les dimensions des pages et l’empreinte du fichier ; chaque mot est limité à 100 caractères. Ces mots peuvent contenir des données réelles du dossier. La reconstruction complète et le contrôle des totaux des écritures sont exécutés localement. Pour récupérer la mise en page, chaque inspection demandée par le modèle peut montrer jusqu’à trois pages ou régions, avec au maximum 300 mots et 1 200 caractères avec coordonnées par page, ainsi que les images demandées. Le modèle lit aussi les recettes proposées et les diagnostics. La procédure conserve l’historique dans le dossier, autorise quatre essais et douze inspections et ne transmet pas ces données aux développeurs.
Le code contrôle tout le journal ; le modèle reçoit l’échantillon et un résumé

Une fois la correspondance des colonnes confirmée, le code contrôle et échantillonne tout le journal. Le modèle reçoit la manière dont l’échantillon a été choisi, les principaux décomptes, l’état des contrôles et de la revue, et jusqu’à 750 lignes sélectionnées avec les 17 champs comptables et de provenance. Il ne reçoit pas le registre du client et de la mission, les fichiers internes utilisés pour gérer la revue, les chemins sur l’ordinateur ni les heures de traitement. Les références aux fichiers sont remplacées par des codes neutres.
Le même échantillon réduit dans chaque mode

Le modèle utilise toujours le même échantillon réduit. Lorsque les outils intégrés sont disponibles, le serveur contrôle localement les données complètes, ne renvoie que les informations réduites prévues et peut enregistrer et appliquer la revue ; sinon les fichiers remis et la procédure locale de Studio Archive conservent les mêmes limites et la même traçabilité. Les références techniques sont remplacées par des codes neutres, mais cela ne pseudonymise pas les données professionnelles : noms, comptes, libellés, identifiants, dates et montants restent présents si nécessaire. Il n'y a ni anonymisation automatique ni garantie de traitement uniquement local.

Lors de la récupération du PDF, le contrôle local de la notation des montants négatifs conserve toutes les anomalies et montre au modèle au plus 50 signalements par réponse, avec page, ligne, colonne et montant imprimé. Le modèle voit aussi les choix proposés de notation et de traitement du signe, qui nécessitent une revue professionnelle. Pour une structure PDF inconnue, l’agent peut lire les mots originaux avec leurs références de page, le code d’un adaptateur local et les écritures partielles nécessaires au diagnostic. Le code s’exécute localement et les contrôles indépendants restent obligatoires. Le service d’incidents reçoit des catégories techniques fixes, les résultats des contrôles et des comptages, sans documents, montants, chemins, code de l’adaptateur ni explications libres. Une relecture réussie ne clôture pas automatiquement le travail initial.

Studio Archive délimite chaque exécution de ce processus et crée automatiquement un rapport des données envoyées par Vera. Vera enregistre ses propres envois ; le rapport n’inspecte ni la conversation ni les autres outils. Le rapport reste sur la machine même lorsque toutes les données ont été envoyées. Les comptages manquants sont signalés comme indéterminés. Le serveur reçoit uniquement l’empreinte du rapport et les références de vérification, liées au Vera userID de la machine, à la même exécution et à la révision. Le contenu du rapport et les preuves restent locaux.
it: Nella mappatura il modello può leggere dati reali del giornale

Il modello riceve le istruzioni e può vedere lo stesso contesto Studio Archive di cliente, incarico e run, la ricevuta e il percorso del file selezionato. Intestazioni, contenuto fornito o righe normalizzate possono essere aperti quando servono a risolvere una specifica ambiguità di mappatura.

Per ogni file l'ispezione prepara al massimo le prime 20 righe canoniche: data, numeri di movimento e riga, conto e descrizioni, dare, avere, importi, valuta, unità e posizione nel file. Per la revisione del layout PDF, il modello può ricevere fino a 300 parole per ciascuna delle prime due pagine e dell’ultima, con coordinate, dimensioni delle pagine e impronta del file; ogni parola è limitata a 100 caratteri. Le parole possono contenere dati reali dello studio. La ricostruzione completa e il controllo dei totali delle registrazioni avvengono localmente. Nel recupero del layout, ogni ispezione richiesta dal modello può mostrare fino a tre pagine o regioni, con al massimo 300 parole e 1.200 caratteri con coordinate per pagina, oltre alle immagini richieste. Il modello legge anche ricette proposte e diagnostica dei tentativi. La procedura conserva la cronologia nel fascicolo, consente quattro tentativi e dodici ispezioni, e non invia questi dati agli sviluppatori.
Il codice controlla tutto il giornale; il modello riceve il campione e un riepilogo

Dopo aver confermato la corrispondenza delle colonne, il codice controlla e campiona l'intero giornale. Il modello riceve come è stato scelto il campione, i conteggi principali, lo stato dei controlli e della revisione e fino a 750 righe selezionate, con tutti i 17 campi contabili e di origine. Non riceve il registro del cliente e dell'incarico, i file interni usati per gestire la revisione, i percorsi sul computer o gli orari di elaborazione. I riferimenti ai file sono sostituiti da codici neutri.
Lo stesso campione ridotto in ogni modalità

Il modello usa sempre lo stesso campione ridotto. Quando sono disponibili gli strumenti integrati, il server controlla localmente i dati completi, restituisce soltanto le informazioni ridotte previste e può salvare e applicare la revisione; in caso contrario, i file consegnati e la procedura locale di Studio Archive mantengono gli stessi limiti e la stessa tracciabilità. I riferimenti tecnici sono sostituiti da codici neutri, ma questo non pseudonimizza i dati professionali: nomi, conti, descrizioni, identificativi, date e importi restano quando servono. Non c'è anonimizzazione automatica né garanzia di elaborazione solo locale.

Nel recupero del PDF, la verifica locale della notazione degli importi negativi conserva tutte le anomalie e mostra al modello al massimo 50 segnalazioni per risposta, con pagina, riga, colonna e importo stampato. Il modello vede anche le scelte proposte per notazione e trattamento del segno; queste richiedono la revisione del professionista. Per strutture PDF non riconosciute, l’agente può leggere le parole originali con i riferimenti di pagina, il codice di un adattatore locale e le scritture parziali necessarie alla diagnosi. Il codice viene eseguito localmente e i controlli indipendenti restano obbligatori. Al servizio incidenti arrivano categorie tecniche fisse, esiti dei controlli e conteggi; non documenti, importi, percorsi, codice dell’adattatore o motivazioni libere. Una rilettura riuscita non chiude automaticamente il lavoro originale.

Studio Archive delimita ogni esecuzione di questo processo e crea automaticamente un report dei dati inviati da Vera. Vera registra i propri invii; il report non ispeziona la chat o altri strumenti. Il report viene conservato sulla macchina anche quando tutti i dati sono stati inviati. I conteggi mancanti sono indicati come non determinabili. Il server riceve soltanto l’impronta del report e i riferimenti di verifica, associati al Vera userID della macchina, alla stessa esecuzione e alla revisione. Il contenuto del report e le evidenze restano locali.

security_controls.control: Only a bounded source-family adapter or complete source-bound reviewed mapping may emit canonical journal rows; every monetary candidate must be disposed, generic PDF layouts abstain, and failed or unsupported qualification emits no population for sampling.

Every product CLI requires a digest-valid running Studio Archive journal-sampling context, replays its customer-folder manifests and receipt-bound bytes, accepts exactly one journal execution copy selected by the run input manifest, and writes normalization and sample artifacts only below that run's exact output root. The context is sealed into diagnostics and review artifacts.

Sampling replays current original-source, captured-parse, reviewed-decision, normalized-population, implementation, and assurance receipts and blocks if the qualified population or its complete monetary disposition has changed.

MCP review save and apply capture the bounded canonical output tree and modes in parent-process memory, execute helpers only against a detached working tree, reject links, aliases, special or oversized entries, and restore exact trusted bytes and modes on failure.

The MCP parent binds caller run, review, decision, and final objects to the persisted trusted snapshot, reconstructs authorized staged arguments, independently validates the persisted result and readiness, and treats helper-returned paths, effects, and status only as non-authoritative acknowledgements.

The deterministic review builder creates model_review_context.json from an allowlisted semantic projection, replaces exact known technical references with stable opaque aliases, removes the client-engagement object, source-path list, timestamps and filesystem paths, and binds the projection to the complete local review digest. MCP tools accept that projection and the current managed-context locator, load full control artifacts locally, reject any projection or caller-state mismatch, and return path-minimized review results. This is technical pseudonymization of references, not anonymization of professional journal data.

The sample stage and each review successor seal the exact regular single-link file, directory and mode set, archive every trusted predecessor under its canonical stage identity, bind the successor to the predecessor manifest, and freshly rederive decisions, effects, counts and non-final gates before accepting save or apply.

Python entrypoints redirect bytecode lookup and disable bytecode writes before validating and loading the declared source implementation. Cache directories and regular bytecode files are excluded from the source receipt set; they are not treated as executable authority. Optional explicit repair removes only ordinary single-link .pyc files directly inside cache folders under this component own vendor tree, without traversing symlinks or falling back to shared vendor roots. This local maintenance path does not add model calls or external destinations.

The local review server requires the session token for output downloads. It accepts only files declared by the local run, within its output directory, rejects symlinks and traversal, and limits downloads to 50 MB. Files are downloaded as opaque bytes; HTML is not executed in the review origin. This does not claim atomic protection from concurrent filesystem changes. The browser may retain a user-requested downloaded copy; this route does not send document content to the model or an external service.

The mapping receipt binds reviewed physical bands and header/footer exclusions to the source digest. Overlapping bands, unmapped money, missing-text body pages, incomplete registrations or unequal registration debit/credit totals withhold the complete source. Page caches are released after each page. No PDF posting is qualified by text readability alone.

Embedded product MCP review resolves the already-ready shared managed Python runtime through the owning product runtime readiness check; it does not install dependencies during review or silently fall back to system Python when that runtime is unavailable. The bridge retains isolated Python execution, managed runtime verification and inherited incident-delivery policy. Explicit Journal Sampling interpreter overrides and standalone component operation retain their existing routes. This adds no model call or external destination.

Explicit zero-valued journal postings remain in the complete locally normalized journal and its source checks. Sampling excludes them before optional filters; the exact excluded count and no-eligible-rows outcome enter the existing audit and bounded model review context. Replay verifies the exclusion and native CSV/XLSX outputs, including empty selections. No new model call or external destination is introduced.

external_boundaries.retention: Packages remain in one fixed user-scoped environment outside plugin source and client folders until explicitly removed. The default location is ~/.local/share/mparanza/runtime/venv on macOS and Linux, and LOCALAPPDATA/mpr/venv on Windows; MPARANZA_RUNTIME_ROOT may override the parent. Enabled OCR remains enabled across later core updates. Package-index request-log retention is controlled by the configured index. Failed updates invalidate the readiness receipt and require repair before execution; this shared environment has no retained generations. Verified temporary code copies are owned by the creating command and removed after completion, failure or cooperative cancellation, with process-exit retry if deletion is temporarily blocked. Preflight verification does not lease a persistent code copy. Installed code, client files and retained professional outputs are not removed. Forced termination or power loss may leave an orphan. On macOS and Linux, fresh code snapshots and native bootstrap copies have private sidecar device/inode records and shared kernel flock leases. Detached native workers inherit the snapshot lease. Normal termination signals stop intake and retain accepted jobs until completion; SIGKILL or power loss can leave copies, recovered on a later verified startup only after an exclusive nonblocking lease proves no holder remains and the directory identity matches. Unmarked historical copies, replaced directories, symlinks and live leases are retained. Lease records contain technical directory identity only, remain outside the indexed code and client folders, and are not returned to the model or sent to a service. Windows retains process-owned cleanup without automatic POSIX orphan recovery. Vera MCP services additionally share a verified immutable code tree keyed by the complete package index hash under the runtime parent/code directory. Kernel leases protect live services; the collector retains two idle releases and never removes client/job state. Active Archive runs retain their original package hash in execution-runtime.json beside their context; reconnects use that verified release while retained. Code storage contains shipped product files only. A missing retired release is explicit and is never silently replaced by newer calculation code. Product service startup and per-run review routing are local and add no external recipient. Native status replies include the technical package hash. The local source installer serializes participating updates and retains the current and previous managed source; direct host updates are outside its lock. Managed CLI command children independently acquire and inherit the same snapshot lease before launch; a terminated launcher cannot release a surviving helper's code. The child keeps that kernel lease until its actual exit. Automatic recovery accepts only lease protocol 2, which guarantees both native-worker and CLI-child inheritance. Older protocol-1 records remain uncollected even without a holder, because legacy helpers may be untracked; current CLI calls may still borrow their leases. Persistent shared-code device/inode metadata is renewed locally after complete package byte verification and a stable identity check during the current verification. This allows filesystem remounts without trusting a stale identity as executable authority. Modified bytes and directory changes during verification remain rejected; unverified replacements do not become eligible for collection. No client content or identity metadata is transmitted by this renewal.

Only EXDEV or Windows error 17 falls back under the same installer lock to a single-link regular-file write with full-byte writes and fsync. Failed writes attempt to restore existing metadata or remove a newly created file; the ready receipt remains invalid until setup succeeds. This fallback is local and does not add a recipient or payload.

Cleanup failures log the temporary path and local OS error; they do not add an external recipient or transmit client content. security_controls.on_violation: Preparation failures and host permission denials stop execution. A failed private copy is removed; no installation chmod/unlink/manual repair, alternate sandbox or relaxed component validation is permitted.

security_controls.control: The parent Vera launcher reports a negative exit code or 137/247 as forced termination. It writes execution_failure.json only inside the selected workflow context output directory or its normalization/sample subdirectories; without that matching context it logs only. The diagnostic stores workflow/run identifiers, exit status and an explicit statement that memory exhaustion is not established by the exit code. It makes no model calls or network requests.
security_controls.on_violation: A worker failure remains failure; diagnostic persistence errors are logged rather than converted into a success.

security_controls.control: The standalone Python bootstrap passes uv only declared host paths, locale, proxy, CA and cache settings, preserving original environment-name casing. Unrelated token/API-key variables and inherited UV_*, VIRTUAL_ENV, CONDA_PREFIX, PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH are excluded; private UV_PYTHON_* and UV_CACHE_DIR values are set by the bootstrap. The same environment is used for interpreter discovery and its local probe.
security_controls.on_violation: Undeclared environment names are absent from every bootstrap child process.

security_controls.control: The built-in incident dependency-setup retry uses the shared host/runtime environment allowlist, named runtime/state locations and recovery recursion guard instead of inheriting unrelated user tokens and keys.
security_controls.on_violation: Undeclared environment names are absent from the child environment.

security_controls.control: When the maintained launcher itself runs under Python -I -B, it restores only its own resolved scripts directory for sibling technical-diagnostic imports. It does not add the caller working directory. Helper execution, diagnostic retention and explicit incident delivery policy remain unchanged.
security_controls.on_violation: The maintained launcher must stop rather than resolving technical diagnostics from the caller working directory.

security_controls.control: Review and product MCP services verify the complete package inventory and SHA-256 hashes in their Node process before starting. They have no persistent Python gateway or old-release routing. When Codex installs a component using hardlinks, only that verified component is copied to ordinary single-link temporary files for its existing implementation validator; the bridge removes its copy on normal exit. Forced termination may leave a temporary component copy. No client data, credentials or additional recipients are involved. Native helper jobs retain their separate existing code ownership.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject altered or missing package code before service startup; never alter the host installation.

security_controls.control: When a managed helper carries a selected Archive context, the launcher checkpoints that exact run before and after the helper. Owner-private storage outside the selected archive retains deduplicated admitted inputs, source-receipt snapshots, completed outputs and run headers. It adds local copies with no external upload or automatic deletion. Recovery selects the same IDs and exact byte hashes, retains changed evidence and refuses unrelated destinations. Missing optional checkpoint storage does not hide a committed result or invalidate unchanged available inputs. The selected model may receive checkpoint status, technical identities and local context/output paths from the owning tool; copying bytes itself does not send them to a model. Standalone helpers without Archive context do not create an Archive run.
security_controls.on_violation: Keep the same job and accessible completed work, expose checkpoint availability separately, and recover only from actual verified copies at an authorized destination. Do not claim inaccessible or unsaved bytes were recovered.
